scientific_integrity: Exact-rational finite polygon calculation and analytic first-variation proof; finite numerical checks only corroborate the theorem. No independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: First variation is local at zero truncation. Its sign is not established at the zero-derivative angle or at arbitrary finite cut size. The global extremal ratio over all planar convex bodies is undetermined. The listed literature is not exhaustive.
title: A sharp first-variation angle for squared random chords under rhombus truncation
